description: This file contains functions and classes for serializing and deserializing dynamic shape specifications used in PyTorch export functionality, including handling of shape ranges, derived dimensions, and symbolic shape representations.

classes.name: RootDim
classes.description: Represents a dimension with minimum, maximum, and derived dimension names.

classes.name: DynamicShapesSpec
classes.description: Stores a dynamic shape specification for serialization and deserialization, including shape data and dimension info.

methods.name: _postprocess_serialized_shapes
methods.description: Converts serialized shape data into a DynamicShapesSpec or dictionary, sorting dimensions and handling optional dictionary output.

methods.name: _dump_dynamic_shapes
methods.description: Serializes dynamic shape information from inputs, args, and kwargs into a structured format for export.

methods.name: _load_dynamic_shapes
methods.description: Deserializes a stored shape specification into a format suitable for shape inference during export.
